module_summary: AXI-Lite to pipelined Wishbone bridge: separate write and read bridge instances each master a Wishbone port, merged onto one bus by a two-master Wishbone arbiter.

anchors.name: i_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid into the write bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address forwarded to write bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid into write bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data passed to write bridge for WB writes.

anchors.name: o_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid from write bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid into the read bridge.

anchors.name: i_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address forwarded to read bridge.

anchors.name: o_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid from read bridge.

anchors.name: o_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data returned by read bridge from WB.

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Shared Wishbone cycle from arbiter output.

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Shared Wishbone strobe from arbiter output.

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Arbitrated Wishbone address from read or write side.

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Arbitrated Wishbone write data.

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack routed by arbiter to owning bridge.

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data fed directly to read bridge.

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall routed back through arbiter.

anchors.name: w_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Write bridge WB cycle request into arbiter channel B.

anchors.name: r_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Read bridge WB cycle request into arbiter channel A.

anchors.name: w_wb_addr
anchors.why: Write bridge WB address into arbiter.

anchors.name: r_wb_addr
anchors.why: Read bridge WB address into arbiter.

anchors.name: w_wb_data

anchors.name: w_wb_ack
anchors.why: Arbiter-routed ack back to write bridge.

anchors.name: r_wb_ack
anchors.why: Arbiter-routed ack back to read bridge.

anchors.name: o_reset
anchors.why: Active-high reset output derived from AXI reset.

groups.name: AXI write bridge
groups.description: Write decoder converting AW/W beats to WB writes and B responses.

groups.name: AXI read bridge
groups.description: Read decoder converting AR requests to WB reads and R responses.

groups.name: Wishbone arbiter
groups.description: Two-master arbiter muxing read and write bridges onto shared WB bus.
